svg.title: Task dependencies and parallel workstreams
svg.desc: Sixteen task cards show owners and all start and closing prerequisites. Core arrows omit transitive links. Optional interpretation review is separate and only affects release if shipped.

svg.text: Asynchronous work and artifact handoffs — same task IDs as the backlog
Solid arrows: core handoffs. Dashed: only if shipped.
First field-to-chat integration happens earlier, while these tasks are in progress.
Start: T02, T06, T08, T09, T11
Core gates pass; submit by 14 Nov 22:00 Istanbul. Official cutoff: 23:59.
Start / Close depend on ready artifacts, not meetings. Owners can work at different times.
Arrows omit prerequisites implied by another path; cards list every prerequisite. Optional T15 has its own start list.
